item.title: [infoq] 代码迁移准确率从 5.4% 飙至 97.9%！OpenAI 挑战 COBOL，几十年的老系统真能交给 AI 了？
item.description: On October 19 OpenAI published research on low-resource programming languages. In a COBOL migration benchmark, GPT-6.1 Sol reached 97.9% accuracy at higher reasoning effort, up from 5.4% for GPT-5.6 Sol at low effort; in a separate 20-language test asking models to build a SQLite-compatible database engine from scratch, GPT-6 Astra averaged 87.4% versus 26.8%. The numbers show AI coding closing its gap on COBOL and Fortran, though handing over decades-old systems is another question.

item.title: [v2ex] [推广] [开源自荐] Linkit：本地优先的 AI 书签管理器，自动摘要 + 语义搜索 + 知识图谱
item.description: Linkit is an open-source desktop bookmark manager built with Go, Wails and React that keeps everything in a local SQLite file, with no account and no telemetry. It auto-summarizes each saved link, searches by meaning rather than keywords, renders the library as a knowledge graph, merges duplicate links and scans for dead ones; AI runs on any OpenAI-compatible API or local Ollama. Ships for macOS, Windows and Linux.

It is aimed at people who still miss Vimperator and found Surfingkeys lacking quick site access.

item.title: [infoq] 对象存储正在“吃掉”Kafka？Cloudflare 用 R2 重做事件流
item.description: Cloudflare has opened a public beta of K2, a serverless event-streaming service that keeps partitioned, durable logs inside R2 object storage, with a stated p99 produce latency of about one second. Because object storage cannot be appended to, K2 batches writes in edge memory and flushes them as segment files, trading latency for cost and elasticity. One beta user measured end-to-end p99 at 7.5 seconds, and the team concedes the tail is worse than expected.

item.title: [infoq] AWS Lambda推动无服务器向长时间运行的工作负载发展
item.description: AWS Lambda now lets functions on Lambda Managed Instances run for up to 90 minutes, six times the old 15-minute ceiling; synchronous request timeouts stay unchanged. That covers media processing, ETL, financial computation and AI inference that previously needed workarounds. AWS warns Lambda offers no exactly-once guarantee, so longer runs widen the retry window — credentials, connections and idempotency, for example via Powertools, need care.

item.title: [hackernews] Eight Bits of Trust: eMudhra's CA keys cracked in milliseconds
item.description: Scott Helme recovered the private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate certificates straight from their public certificates in under a second, because the keys were tiny integers such as 4, 56 and 115. The compromise was reported to Apple, Google, Microsoft, Mozilla and eMudhra on 17 October; Chrome shipped a CRLSet block that evening and Firefox followed hours later through OneCRL.

item.title: [juejin] 甲方只给了一张卫星截图，我用 Three.js + Blender 建了一座 3D 能源站
item.description: Given nothing but a satellite screenshot and a facility list, the author reverse-engineered a scale and site layout, then modeled the whole energy station in Blender 5.1 through Python scripts and baked ground lighting with Cycles. The front end is Vue 3 + Vite rendering a three.js scene with an orthographic camera, UnrealBloomPass glow, RectAreaLight and InstancedMesh, plus truck-docking and operations simulation. item.title: [juejin] 用了一个月 WorkBuddy，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: A heavy two-year GPT user recounts a month on WorkBuddy after leaving a third-party relay API that timed out at peak hours, dropped context mid-task, and could disappear with prepaid balances. WorkBuddy offers 2000 signup credits and bundles GLM-5.3, Kimi and DeepSeek, so models can be picked per task to control cost, and jobs can be dispatched from WeChat on a phone.

item.title: [github_trending] Meloong-Git/PCL
item.description: PCL (Plain Craft Launcher) is a Minecraft launcher whose GitHub repository publishes most of its source code, including the UI library, animation module, download module and Minecraft launch module. Developers who want to see how a launcher is put together, or reuse parts of one, can read the code directly.

item.title: [github_trending] fastapi/fastapi
item.description: FastAPI is a Python web framework positioned around high performance, quick learning and fast coding, with a production-ready claim in its own description; it ships on PyPI, with documentation at fastapi.tiangolo.com and source on GitHub. Python developers weighing a backend framework can evaluate it against their current stack.
